title: Test and E2E migration to the overhauled UI
description: Rewrite RTL and Playwright selectors to roles/labels for the new layout while preserving E2E-01..05 and mobile coverage; regenerate OpenAPI types from the test API.
acceptance_criteria: Given the e2e stack, when Playwright runs, then E2E-01..05 and mobile pass without CSS-class selectors.
Given CI, then src/api/generated.ts equals openapi-typescript output from the test API on port 8001.
verification: All 8 E2E passed on a fresh e2e DB (36.7s), and again after the legacy cleanup (34.5s). A Playwright project dependency runs the research save journey first. The generated contract matches the test API on 8001 (cmp). Vitest 290/290, ESLint 0 problems, strict tsc clean.
